workload.description: One entry of the main input a helper reads, writes or judges: an exception record, a finding, a rule of a policy config, a requirement field or a classification. Each function says which. 640 is a very large registry.

contribution.description: Called once per run, between reading and writing the registry, but not attributed: the end-to-end run reconciles a registry in which every finding matches, while this benchmark holds the registry at 640 records with only some findings matching, so its time would misstate that share.
